zones.name: South Outer Perimeter & Gatehouse
zones.description: Triple-reinforced gatehouse with electric fences (M10_T12_01, M10_T12_02), Sentry Turrets (M10_T9_01, M10_T9_02), and 2 panning cameras; Player Start at [100.0, 10.0] in the southern drainage culvert.

zones.name: Outer Courtyard & Barracks
zones.description: Open cobblestone courtyard patrolled by E2 Grunts, E4 Elites, and E11 Medics (who revive knocked-out guards in 5s), protected by Motion Sensors M10_T6_01 & M10_T6_02, Laser Grids M10_T5_01 & M10_T5_02, and Alarmed Doors M10_T13_01 & M10_T13_02.

zones.name: Central Headquarters Building
zones.description: 3-story concrete command building: Floor 1 Lobby & holding access, Floor 2 Server Room at [304.0, 350.0] (Secondary Objective S1), and Floor 3 Executive Suite & Boss Arena where Commander Rask (M10_E14_01) awaits at [400.0, 530.0] (Primary Objective O1).

zones.name: Underground Garage & Cellblock
zones.description: Subterranean bunker level secured by Booby-trapped Doors M10_T14_01 and M10_T14_02 (deadly 120 dmg explosion if opened fast; counter: slow peek + 3s disarm wire) and housing the Prisoner Cell at [330.0, 250.0] (Secondary Objective S2).

zones.name: North Inner Courtyard
zones.description: Inner fortress courtyard connecting the Central Headquarters Building to the extraction LZ at [400.0, 450.0] and the northern helipad.

zones.name: North Helipad & Armored Garage Extraction
zones.description: Northern helipad and armored garage sector supporting Extraction Point [400.0, 450.0] (radius: 10.0m — triggers extraction helicopter arrival upon eliminating Commander Rask).

primary.title: Assassinate Commander Rask at (400, 530) & extract via helipad or garage truck

secondary.title: Free prisoner in underground garage cell at (330, 250) (Ghost Medal)

events.description: When Alert Level 3 triggers or Commander Rask is engaged on Floor 3, Compound Zero enters fortress lockdown and deploys Elite bodyguards.
Upon eliminating Commander Rask at [400.0, 530.0], the extraction helicopter arrives at [400.0, 450.0] (radius: 10.0m).

silent.name: Silent Route (Drainage Pipe, Slow-Peek T14 Disarm, Prisoner Rescue S2 & Rask Assassination)
silent.description: Infiltrate from southern drainage culvert [100, 10] -> advance along West covert channel [100, 250] -> slow-peek & disarm Booby-trapped Door M10_T14_01 at [260, 250] -> free Prisoner in Underground Cell at [330, 250] (S2) -> ascend through doorway [330, 330] to Floor 3 Boss Arena at [400, 530] to assassinate Commander Rask (O1) -> extract at [400, 450].

technical.name: Technical Route (Gate Generator Hack, EMP Turrets/Lasers, Floor 2 Server Wipe S1 & Chopper Extraction)
technical.description: Advance from [100, 10] to [180, 350] bypassing outer turrets -> enter HQ West technical doorway [280, 350] -> wipe Floor 2 Mainframe Servers at [304, 350] (S1) & disable camera monitor M10_MON_01 -> ascend to [400, 530] to eliminate Commander Rask (O1) -> extract at [400, 450].

loud.name: Loud Route (Center Gatehouse Breach, Courtyard Firefight vs Elites/Medics & Boss Arena Assault)
loud.description: Push from [100, 10] to [400, 10] -> breach Zone A Gatehouse & T9 turrets along [400, 200] -> storm HQ South Center doorway [400, 330] -> eliminate Commander Rask & his Elite guard at [400, 530] (O1) -> secure Extraction LZ at [400, 450].
